summary: Master social media marketing for the tourism and hospitality industry. Join our training course to enhance your skills and attract more guests today!
lede: Social Media Marketing for Tourism and Hospitality provides a practical framework for turning social activity into stronger booking decisions, guest relationships, and measurable business results. You will learn to plan multi-platform campaigns, tailor content to different audiences and platforms, and connect performance with revenue across the guest journey. The course covers seasonal content planning, paid social advertising, influencer partnerships, user-generated content, reputation management, crisis communication, social listening, and attribution. It also addresses limited budgets, seasonal demand changes, platform algorithm shifts, and the need to demonstrate return on investment.
audienceIntro: This course addresses the specific needs of tourism and hospitality professionals responsible for driving bookings, managing brand reputation, and maximizing revenue through social media channels.
audience: Hotel General Managers and Tourism Business Owners
modules: Social Media Landscape and Tourism Industry Context
Paid Social Advertising and Campaign Optimization
Social Commerce and Direct Booking Optimization
prerequisites: This course assumes basic familiarity with social media platforms and general marketing principles. Participants should have experience managing social media accounts for business purposes and access to relevant social media management tools. No advanced technical skills are required, but participants should be comfortable with digital analytics and campaign performance measurement concepts.
